newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin Q4 dil shr $2.11 with gains.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin Q4 dil shr $2.11 with gains.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: Earnings per share for the fourth quarter 1996 were $1.47 diluted, excluding non-recurring gains and charges. The figure in the table above ($2.11) includes non-recurring, after-tax net gains of $142 million.
For the entire year earnings were $5.40 per share diluted, excluding non-recurring items. Earnings for 1995 were $5.01 per share, excluding charges relating to a merger.
The company said its backlog at year-end was $50 billion, up from $41 billion at the end of 1995.
The company said it generated free cash flow of nearly $1 billion even after investing in consolidation actions.
Non-recurring items in fourth quarter 1996 included a pre-tax gain of $365 million which increased net earnings by $351 million, or $1.58 per share, assuming full dilution.
The gain was offset by pre-tax charges of $325 million which decreased net earnings by $209 million, or $0.94 per share, assuming full dilution.
There was a $690 million pre-tax charge taken in 1995 to reflect the merger with Marietta, the company added.
